# TransformJS

TransformJS is a free, privacy-first, browser-based developer toolkit.

Website: https://transformjs.com
GitHub: https://github.com/Tzioan4/transformJS

## What it does

TransformJS provides lightweight web tools for developers who need to format, convert, preview, debug, parse, and generate common development data directly in the browser.

All tools run locally in the user's browser. TransformJS does not require accounts, does not use analytics, does not track users, and does not send user input to a server.

## Main tools

- JSON Formatter: format, validate, beautify, and minify JSON.
- Base64 Tool: encode and decode Base64 strings.
- URL Encoder / Decoder: encode and decode URL-safe text.
- HTML Preview: preview HTML and CSS snippets in a sandboxed iframe.
- Markdown Preview: preview Markdown as sanitized HTML.
- JWT Debugger: decode JWT tokens and verify HMAC signatures locally.
- YAML to JSON: convert YAML input into JSON.
- SQL Formatter: format SQL queries.
- Hash Generator: generate MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, and SHA-512 hashes.
- Password Generator: generate secure random passwords.
- CSV to JSON: convert CSV data into JSON.
- RegEx Tester: test regular expressions with match highlighting.
- FTL Previewer: preview FreeMarker templates with mock JSON data.
- Case Converter: convert text between camelCase, PascalCase, snake_case, kebab-case, and more.
- UUID Generator: generate UUID values.
- URL Parser: inspect URL parts such as protocol, host, path, query params, and hash.
- Diff Checker: compare two text blocks line by line.
- Color Converter: convert colors between HEX, RGB, and HSL.

## Key facts

- Free to use.
- Open source.
- Built with React and Vite.
- Runs in the browser.
- Privacy-first.
- No accounts.
- No analytics.
- No tracking.
- No server-side processing of user input.
- Designed for developers and technical users.
